utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’ll need the exact start time and what supplies to bring so I can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Pia — it’s Sunday at the community center, and we’ll start at 10 a.m. Please bring a screwdriver, a small hammer, and any spare extension cords if you have them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, what time do you need me on the front porch Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can be there Saturday morning on the front porch for the repair drive. Just let me know the time, and I’ll help out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch — I’m happy to help, just tell me what time you need me there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. Just come by Saturday on the front porch, and I’ll put you where you’re needed most.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — I’m still in for the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Wonderful, Sam — thank you! I’ll keep you posted with the final helper list and any last-minute details for Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. I’ll let you know what needs doing Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, just let me know. I’ll be there Saturday on the front porch and can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks, Oren — I’m still rounding up helpers for Saturday on the front porch, and I’d really appreciate you pitching in if you can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, I’d be glad to help on Saturday on the front porch. Just let me know what time you need me there and what you want me to do.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Come by at 9 a.m. on the front porch, and I’ll be there to help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll be there at 9 a.m. on the front porch.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
